entities.summary: Roman, a notable figure in the history of North Macedonia, associated with Roman Macedonia (168 BCE–284). Preceded by Apostle Paul preaches in Macedonia (c. 50 CE) and Rome defeats Perseus and establishes province of Macedonia. Their legacy influenced Late Roman & Early Christian Period.
